subject: Mobile Development
title: Wi-Fi 7 and the Future of Wireless
description: A 60-second lesson on Wi-Fi 7 and the Future of Wireless.

hook.text: Wi-Fi 7 delivers speeds up to 46 Gbps — fast enough to download a 4K movie in seconds.

buildup.text: Multi-link operation lets Wi-Fi 7 use multiple frequency bands simultaneously.

discovery.text: Ultra-low latency makes Wi-Fi 7 suitable for cloud gaming and real-time AR applications.

twist.text: Most homes don't have internet connections fast enough to take advantage of Wi-Fi 7 speeds.

climax.text: Wi-Fi 7 is built for the future — when homes, offices, and devices catch up.

punchline.text: The Wi-Fi is faster than the internet behind it.

quiz.question: What is a key feature of Wi-Fi 7?
options: Multi-link operation across multiple frequency bands
